notes: Sepolia (11155111) application deployment, contracts only: kind evm_contracts takes no token, no liquidity pool and no reward distributor, and $token does not resolve in it. The only token involved is the elastic CompToken the vault creates in its own constructor, which is not a launch artifact. PriceFeed, NhiFeed and SpotFeed precede ParameterizedVault, which references them by name. Feed constructor arguments are maxAge in seconds and maxDeviationBps: 86400/2000, 86400/2000 and 3600/2000. These preserve the existing manifest settings; the deployment scripts instead use 5000 for maxDeviationBps. The vault's first argument is an explicit faucet sentinel, not an address: it tells the constructor to deploy a fresh MockIMD itself, so the project is constructible on any chain. A LITERAL address was what parked an earlier launch, because it has code only on the chain it was deployed to and the protected-invariant harness constructs the project on a bare chain. Zero is NOT used for this, because zero is what an unset manifest field looks like and a vault quietly taking a mock token as collateral would accept a worthless asset against real debt. Zero CompToken and work-oracle arguments create and bind fresh CompToken and MockWorkOracle contracts during construction; the work-oracle argument is deliberately zero, which is the grantRights faucet, because the attested SwarmWorkOracle is requested with a sentinel that requires a WorkOracleFactory already deployed and named in source, and that is not a manifest deployment. The vault also creates its own Parameters, Treasury and UsdPriceFeed; they are not additional manifest deployments. Protocol liquidation revenue and minted stability fees go to that Treasury. workCeiling is reserveValue() plus backedDebt() times workRatioBps divided by 10000. reserveValue() is Treasury reserveValueUsd() with no conversion, because the vault denominates positions in USD through a UsdPriceFeed it creates from the primary feed and Chainlink ETH/USD; an asset whose price source is stale or unreadable counts as zero. The earlier ETH conversion was removed when the vault became dollar-denominated. backedDebt() is the lesser of current and transaction-start totalDebt, less totalBadDebt, floored at zero. The ratio starts at 2500 and Parameters caps it at 2500. Feeds start unseeded and the Treasury reserve register starts empty. No initialization calls are included. Feed authorities, the existing attestation relayer, payload chainId 1, answerType 3, quorum 1, Chainlink USD source and approved operator remain source-defined. No constructor accepts an owner and no privileged wallet is supplied by this manifest; source-defined authority remains subject to independent policy and authorization review. Services own policy, signed artifact linkage, admission and deployment; these notes do not authorize them.
